# Overview
Purpose is to check error distribution for BMP data.

# Analysis

Load data

```{r}
library(data.table)
```

```{r}
BMP <- fread('../data/BMP.csv')
```

Fit linear fixed-effects model to make diagnostic plots easier.

```{r}
mod1 <- lm(BMP ~ test_id + lab_id + substrate, data = BMP)
summary(mod1)
```

Diagnostics

```{r}
plot(mod1, ask = FALSE)
```

Try lognormal.


```{r}
mod2 <- lm(log10(BMP) ~ test_id + lab_id + substrate, data = BMP)
summary(mod2)
```

Diagnostics

```{r}
plot(mod2, ask = FALSE)
```

# Conclusion
No major evidence of heteroscedastiscity.
But some deviation from normality in errors.
Log transformation does not help issue that much.
But it is most likely related to unusual extreme values.
